## Example 1.7(b) {#dc1-example-1-7-b .dc-lesson}

<p>Differentiate the following expressions with respect to <span data-math="x"></span>.</p>
<div class="dc-problem-list"><div><span class="part">b)</span><span data-math="y=\frac{e^x}{x^2}"></span></div></div><p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 6 · Example 1.7(b)</p>

::: notes
Let u=e^x, v=x²; u'=e^x and v'=2x. y'=(x²e^x−2xe^x)/x^4=e^x(x−2)/x³, x≠0. Retain the correct subtraction order and square the entire denominator. Accept product rule applied to x^-2 e^x as an equivalent method, if offered. Work in OneNote. About three minutes.
:::
